jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six, to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!

 **Job Description** **Develop at Ubisoft** is a mentorship program for students and recent graduates (with less than two years of experience) looking to grow their skills in Game Design, Audio, Programming, or Cybersecurity.


This initiative supports individuals from genders historically underrepresented in gaming and STEM.

 **Develop at Ubisoft** is one of several talent programs we offer to engage and support different audiences across the industry.

**Please note: this program is a mentorship program and is not tied to any hiring process.**


From January to May 2027, selected mentees will work on a project based on a given theme. They will be mentored by volunteer Ubisoft developers, including from our mobile studios, who will provide feedback and guidance throughout the mentorship to help them develop their own personal project.


In the **Programming track**, you will develop and submit a game using either C\+\+ or C\# with a freely available development tool, such as Unity for mobile.

 **Qualifications** **Eligibility criteria:**

* At least 18 years old
* Currently enrolled in studies, or graduated in Spring 2024 or later
* Fewer than 2 years of professional experience
* Legally entitled to work in the country of application
* Applications may be submitted to only one location
* Individual entries only – team entries will not be considered

**Additional criteria for Toronto applicants:**

* Must be a student or recent graduate
* Must be a resident of Ontario
* Must have attended a recognized school, college or university in Ontario

**This program is designed to support early\-career professionals from underrepresented genders – female and nonbinary – in the industry. By submitting an application, you confirm that you meet and accept the eligibility criteria outlined above.**


Apply with your **resume, cover letter** and, if available, a **portfolio**. Please also select your **preferred track and location**.

 **Additional Information** **Application period:** **October 1st – October 31st**

**We are looking for mentees in the locations where our participating studios are based:**

**Canada** (Montreal, Saguenay,Toronto);

**France** (Bordeaux, Lyon \- Ivory Tower, Montpellier, Paris);

**Germany** (Berlin, Kolibri Games (mobile) \- Berlin, Düsseldorf, Mainz);

**Italy** (Milan)**;**

**Singapore;**

**Sweden** (Malmö \- Massive Entertainment);

jobs.description:
* **Location(s):**
* Swindon, Wiltshire, GB, SN5 6PB
**RWE Supply \& Trading GmbH**


**Start date:** September 2027  

**Salary:** starting at £41,000 p.a


Are you looking to kickstart your career at a company where you can truly make an impact? Whether we’re delivering power to millions, trading in new markets around the globe, or driving the rapid growth of renewable energy, RWE is at the forefront of the industry. But we wouldn’t be there without world\-class IT.

  

  

**About the role**


The IT Developer Graduate Programme is designed for graduates who want to build a career in software engineering and application development, placing you at the heart of our commercial business.


Through a series of hands\-on technical rotations, you’ll work closely with analysts and business support teams to deliver solutions for our energy trading and commercial operations teams, while developing expertise in programming, cloud\-native technologies and DevOps practices.


Along the way, you’ll broaden your technical stack and business knowledge, gain experience across a range of programming languages and working environments, and build an understanding of different teams and cultures, providing a strong foundation for your permanent role and long\-term career development.


You’ll learn about our global business from the inside – working on meaningful projects in areas including:


* Application development.
* Embedded IT for our commercial business such as trading of energy commodities, freight and logistics, commercial asset optimisation or sales and origination.
* Enterprise Integration focus on the transport layer within RWEST’s application landscape and works closely together with other IT and business teams to optimise the systems.
* Market Data Solutions are the fuel for decision\-making, automated trading, and fundamental analysis within the Energy Trading industry.
* Central Services are positioned in middle layer (Integration) applications connecting to various other departments like BackOffice, Risk and Front Office etc. involving incident management, automated standard service requests, working with concepts of DevOps and Squad model and migration of application to cloud based infrastructure.
* IT projects with business attention such as “Lead in Data” or “Lead in Cloud”.

Digital technologies, including AI\-enabled tools, are becoming an integral part of how we work at RWE. Throughout the programme, you will have opportunities to use these tools responsibly to enhance productivity, support decision\-making, foster innovation and improve ways of working, always in line with RWE policies and responsible use principles.


Whichever team you join, you’ll be welcomed as an equal. Your perspective will be valued. You’ll be trusted to deliver the work you’re given. And with each new rotation, you’ll develop the skills and knowledge you need to become an industry expert.

  

  

**Job requirements and experiences**

Are you passionate about IT, digital technologies, and innovative solutions? Committed to building a career in the energy industry? Keen to learn, grow and take ownership and accountability? Then you could be just the kind of exceptional person we’re looking for. Some relevant work experience would be an advantage but is not essential.

  

  

As well as a keen interest in the energy industry and the readiness to explore our markets and our business, you’ll need:


* A degree (BSc, MSc or PhD) in IT or a similar statistical or numerate subject such as Mathematics, Engineering or Economics.
* Knowledge of at least one of the following programming languages \- C\#, Java or Python.
* Passion for IT development and working in a DevOps environment.
* Interest in AI, Automation, and other emerging technologies.
* A positive, team\-oriented approach to work.
* Motivation to take on new challenges.
* A commercial and analytical mindset.
* Adaptability and the ability to learn quickly.
* Enthusiasm for developing your skills and exploring new opportunities.
* Fluent English.
  

  

**From here, you’ll have a community of support**


While you’re on our graduate journey, we’re committed to providing you with a range of opportunities to grow and develop your skills. Alongside job rotations and technical training, you’ll be provided with comprehensive behavioural skills training with our expert partner, Cappfinity. This will enable you to harness your strengths from day one and identify new ways to utilise the key Skills That Build Skills. This will support you to reach your potential and goals, shaping your career path. The behavioural skills training is immersive, including interactive sessions where you can learn from our facilitators and your own peers, and self\-led elements to support your application of learning back in your day\-to\-day role.


Our graduate programmes have been designed to give you the chance to shape your own career path and personal development, with the support you need to succeed. You’ll have access to a graduate buddy and a senior mentor within your field who can advise you on rotations and introduce you to key people within the business.


RWE is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment – we value your passion, your willingness to learn and your desire to thrive. Even if you don't have all the above skills, need flexible working arrangements or other adjustments not yet listed here, we'd love to hear from you.

  

  

**Your benefits**


At RWE, we’ll do everything we can to support you in fulfilling your potential. Our benefits include:


* Competitive salary plus annual discretionary bonus.
* Company pension and discounted employee share scheme.
* 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to buy 5 extra days.
* Two paid annual volunteer days for a charity or initiative of your choice.
* International rotations with financial support for relocation.
* Enhanced family\-friendly policies, including maternity support.
* Free on\-site healthcare and access to AXA Private Healthcare Scheme.
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with confidential support for work, health, or life matters.
* Access to modern offices, state\-of\-the\-art IT and diverse employee networks.
* Flexible benefits, including retail discounts.

Avanade is a global leader in digital, cloud, and AI‑driven solutions. As a joint venture between Microsoft and Accenture, we are the world’s largest consulting company fully focused on Microsoft technologies.

We help our clients design, build, and scale innovative solutions across Cloud, Applications, Data & AI, and Security, based on a strong #PeopleFirst culture.

Your Role

As an AI Software Engineer (Full stack, Frontend, Backend)
, you design, develop, and integrate AI
‑ enabled and Generative AI
‑ powered solutions
into modern applications.

You work hands‑on across the full stack while applying AI technologies to enhance user experiences, automate processes, and deliver measurable business value.

Depending on your experience, you may also lead small development teams, mentor colleagues, and contribute to solution design and technical decision
‑ making
.

You collaborate closely with product owners, designers, architects, and other engineers as part of multidisciplinary delivery teams.

Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure full‑stack applications
Integrate Generative AI capabilities into applications and development workflows
Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI agents to support automation and improved user interaction
Implement AI‑driven features using modern frameworks, APIs, and services
Collaborate with designers, product owners, and fellow developers to deliver high‑quality software
Participate across the entire software lifecycle, from requirements analysis to production deployment and support
Write clean, maintainable, and well‑tested code aligned with best practices
Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve technical issues across applications and AI components
Stay up to date with emerging AI technologies and actively contribute to continuous improvement

Your Profile

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
2+ years of professional experience in software or full‑stack development
Hands‑on experience using AI and Generative AI tools in application development
Proven experience designing and deploying Generative AI agents or AI‑powered features
Strong experience with front‑end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js
Solid backend/API development experience with Python, .NET Core, Node.js
Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g. SQL Server, Cosmos DB)
Understanding of containers and container orchestration
Experience with Azure or other major cloud platforms
Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and DevOps practices
Strong problem‑solving skills and attention to detail
Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset
Fluency in German and English are a mandatory requirement

Qualifications

Nice to Have

Experience leading or mentoring development teams
Familiarity with Azure OpenAI, Copilot, AI orchestration frameworks, or agent frameworks
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud‑native architectures
Background in consulting or customer‑facing project delivery

What Sets You Apart

Strong interest in applying AI to real‑world business problems
Hands‑on, solution‑oriented mindset
Ability to explain complex technical topics in a clear and structured way
High level of ownership, curiosity, and continuous‑learning attitude
Comfortable working in multidisciplinary and international teams

What We Offer

Opportunity to work for the Microsoft Global Alliance Partner of the Year
Access to extensive learning and certification programs, including AI and cloud technologies
Collaboration with experienced architects, AI specialists, and engineers globally
Clear career paths toward Senior AI Developer, Technical Lead, or AI Architect
Competitive, performance‑based compensation aligned with your experience and location
Compensation varies depending on role, location, experience, and skill set.
We place great importance on performance-based and competitive remuneration and, depending on your experience and qualifications, offer you an attractive compensation package.

The Perfect Place to Work

More than 60,000 professionals, 26 countries, and one universe — that’s Avanade. No matter the digital challenge, we find the solution within the Microsoft ecosystem. Because one thing is clear: we come from good stock. Accenture LLP and Microsoft Corporation brought us into being in the year 2000. Naturally, we skillfully combine the best of both worlds.

If you decide to contribute your skills and individual talents at Avanade, you will be rewarded with unique experiences, unlimited learning opportunities, and ambitious growth.

And while we continue to invest in our diverse and inclusive culture — becoming even more innovative and creative along the way — we ensure that our clients benefit from our technological innovations and that our communities thrive. You will become part of a smart team that supports, encourages, guides you, and relies on your expertise. The perfect start at a company founded to implement mission‑critical, leading technology solutions while also striving to improve the way people work, interact, and live.

Do What Matters

We believe that inclusive and diverse teams can overcome any challenge — if you face challenges with passion and courage, you are exactly right with us. Your application is welcome regardless of your background, nationality, faith, disability, age, marital status, partnership status, sexual orientation, or gender. With us, you can simply be yourself.
